title: clematis alpina subsp. occidentalis
intro: Clematis alpina subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Alpina Clematis, is a flowering plant species within the Clematis genus. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating anxiety, thanks to its therapeutic actions as an anxiolytic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Western Alpina Clematis include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
